title: Reading Drill — Surveying arrivals at a public pool — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Surveying arrivals at a public pool — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The pool supervisor in Foxhaven received an old report about families reaching the ticket counter just before classes change. The report compared the length of the peak queue, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the entrance counts rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered six weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include changes in class size. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed staggered start times as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
